evidence: Defines Testnet 5 chain parameters, difficulty adjustment rules, and consensus activation heights in src/kernel/chainparams.cpp and consensus definitions.
rationale: Adds Testnet 5 (BIP 95) consensus parameters, eliminating the 20-minute difficulty reset to end block storms and enforcing BIP 54 rules from block 1. According to the PR description and commit ef12208cc0, Testnet 5 addresses recurring failure modes of Testnet 3/4 by dropping the '20-minute minimum-difficulty exception' and raising minimum difficulty to 'nBits 0x1a0fffff'. Establishing a stable public test network with upcoming consensus cleanup rules represents durable, strategically important infrastructure for validating consensus changes.
